Remark
[two-sided metric comparison]

Source: petersen:page-0285 ↗ def:pet-ch6-jacobi-field ↗ thm:pet-ch6-rauch-comparison 1. ch6:6.7.15Let $r(x)=|xp|$ with $-K\le \sec \le K$, $g=dr^2+g_r$ on $(0,R)\times S^{n-1}$, $2R<\operatorname {inj}_p$. (1) Show $\operatorname {sn}_K^2(r)\, ds_{n-1}^2\le g_r\le \operatorname {sn}_{-K}^2(r)\, ds_{n-1}^2$. (2) Show there is a universal constant $C$ with $|\operatorname {Hess}\tfrac 12r^2-g|\le CK^2R^2$ for $R<\pi /(2\sqrt K)$.
